original_test_intent: Build the approved clpeak revision against the intended NVIDIA OpenCL ICD, run it on every in-scope GPU, and verify the defined utilization and performance outputs fall within the platform-approved ranges.
original_method: Pin repository and every submodule commit; inventory OS/compiler/CMake/OpenCL loader/ICD/driver and GPU UUID/BDF/device order; define all-device scope and metric/oracle; preserve baseline/isolate jobs; build in controlled directory with manifest; run tracked per approved scope with telemetry/timeout; capture every device/test metric and exit; compare thresholds; stop contexts, audit build artifacts and verify GPU/log health.
manual_activity: OpenCL/benchmark owner pins source/ICD/device scope and defines metrics; operator approves sustained load; agent may build/run and compare after inputs are fixed.
required_inputs: Pinned clpeak commit and recursive submodule commit/hash manifest
GPU UUID/BDF to OpenCL platform/device order map and intended scope
Isolation, telemetry/timeout and context/GPU recovery approval
safety_requirements: Never update submodules from remote during controlled run
Do not install/switch ICD or library paths without rollback
Never infer device order or all-GPU coverage from one default run
Track/stop contexts and preserve raw output; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Build reproducibly and run approved device scope
engineer_actions: Define GPU scope and expected metric/range/aggregation

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A credentialed `clpeak` binary call omits the source build, pinned submodules, ICD selection, device mapping and undefined expected utilization.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Build pinned clpeak/submodules against the approved NVIDIA ICD, run with explicit device scope if supported, preserve complete per-device test output and correlate external utilization telemetry to the approved oracle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Clone/build/run flow and 60-minute estimates are retained; `--remote` is replaced only after explicit pinned-commit approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an immutable source/build manifest and a table mapping each OpenCL device to GPU UUID/BDF, clpeak metrics, utilization telemetry and threshold result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the build reproducible and subjective utilization criterion measurable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A CUDA benchmark cannot replace the OpenCL ICD/kernel path, and one default device cannot prove all GPUs.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: clpeak exposes many microbenchmarks whose utilization patterns differ; one utilization threshold may be invalid without test-specific aggregation.

project_override_considerations: Benchmark owner defines whether every clpeak microtest and GPU must pass, which utilization source is authoritative, and metric/range thresholds per test/device.
expected_evidence: GPU UUID/BDF to OpenCL device map and exact scope/argv
Complete per-device clpeak output/exits and metric units
Timestamp-aligned utilization/temperature/power plus approved threshold calculation
dmesg/XID/PCIe/BMC/SEL deltas, cleanup/final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria says all GPU utilizations should be expected but does not define device scope, utilization source, numeric range, per-test timing or aggregation; Procedure also follows moving submodule heads.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; reproducible source/ICD and oracle inputs are provisionable.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row288 Wistron-NV GPU-00281-V002: pin clpeak and every submodule instead of `--remote`, identify NVIDIA OpenCL ICD and GPU device order/scope, and define authoritative utilization/performance fields, units, per-test timing, numeric ranges/reference and all-device aggregation.

review_improvement: Makes OpenCL provenance/device coverage reproducible and converts vague expected utilization into traceable per-device metrics.
independent_technical_reasoning: Remote submodule heads can change code independently of the main commit, invalidating reproducibility. OpenCL platform/device order need not match nvidia-smi ordinals, and a default run may choose only one platform or device. Utilization varies by clpeak microtest, so time-aligned external telemetry and test-specific performance fields must be tied to a defined range rather than judged visually.
